Solving the pair gives \(x=23\) and \(y=22\), so \(\angle A = 95^\circ\) and \(\angle B = 75^\circ\). Hence \(\angle A + \angle B = 170^\circ\).

solution: The largest square inscribed in an equilateral triangle rests on one of its sides. With \(s = 6+4\sqrt{3}\), \(x = (6+4\sqrt{3})(2\sqrt{3}-3) = 6\) cm, so the area of the square is \(36\ \text{cm}^2\).
